Project Title:

ai-ml-ds-R9X8P7N6M5 – Integrated Customer Churn Prediction Pipeline with Meta-Learning, Data Augmentation, and Interpretability

File Name:

integrated_customer_churn_prediction_pipeline.py

This project implements an end-to-end customer churn prediction pipeline that leverages advanced scikit-learn functionalities combined with complementary modules such as imbalanced-learn, XGBoost, Optuna, MLflow, Dask, SHAP, and joblib. The pipeline handles heterogeneous data (numerical and categorical), performs robust preprocessing (imputation, outlier removal, encoding, scaling), applies feature engineering and selection, and builds a meta-learning ensemble for classification. Additionally, the project integrates hyperparameter optimization, distributed computing, and model interpretability to create a production-grade solution. This project is ideal for large-scale enterprise churn analysis, with potential applications in customer retention strategies and business intelligence.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Integrated Customer Churn Prediction Pipeline with Meta-Learning,
Data Augmentation, and Model Interpretability

Project Reference: ai-ml-ds-R9X8P7N6M5
File: integrated_customer_churn_prediction_pipeline.py
Timestamp: 2025-04-01

# ==========================
# Import Libraries and Modules
# ==========================
import os  # type: ignore
import time  # type: ignore
import warnings  # type: ignore
import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import pandas as pd  # type: ignore
import shap  # type: ignore
import optuna  # type: ignore
import mlflow  # type: ignore
import joblib  # type: ignore
from dask.distributed import Client, LocalCluster  # type: ignore

from sklearn.base import BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin  # type: ignore
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline  # type: ignore
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer  # type: ignore
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer, KNNImputer  # type: ignore
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, MinMaxScaler, OneHotEncoder, OrdinalEncoder, PolynomialFeatures  # type: ignore
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA, TruncatedSVD  # type: ignore
from sklearn.feature_selection import SelectKBest, f_classif, RFE  # type: ignore
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier, GradientBoostingClassifier, StackingClassifier, VotingClassifier  # type: ignore
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression  # type: ignore
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, StratifiedKFold, cross_val_score  # type: ignore
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, roc_auc_score, classification_report  # type: ignore

from imblearn.over_sampling import SMOTE  # type: ignore
from xgboost import XGBClassifier  # type: ignore

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ==========================
# Custom Transformers
# ==========================

class OutlierRemover(BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin):
    """
    Custom transformer to remove outliers using IsolationForest.
    """
    def __init__(self, contamination: float = 0.05) -> None:
        self.contamination: float = contamination
        from sklearn.ensemble import IsolationForest  # local import
        self.iforest: IsolationForest = IsolationForest(contamination=self.contamination, random_state=42)

    def fit(self, X: pd.DataFrame, y: pd.Series = None) -> "OutlierRemover":
        self.iforest.fit(X)
        return self

    def transform(self, X: pd.DataFrame, y: pd.Series = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
        preds: np.ndarray = self.iforest.predict(X)
        mask: np.ndarray = preds == 1
        X_clean: pd.DataFrame = X.loc[mask].reset_index(drop=True)
        return X_clean

class AdvancedFeatureEngineer(BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin):
    """
    Transformer for advanced feature engineering.
    Generates polynomial features and custom interaction terms.
    """
    def __init__(self, poly_degree: int = 2, include_bias: bool = False) -> None:
        self.poly_degree: int = poly_degree
        self.include_bias: bool = include_bias
        self.poly: PolynomialFeatures = PolynomialFeatures(degree=self.poly_degree, include_bias=self.include_bias)

    def fit(self, X: pd.DataFrame, y: pd.Series = None) -> "AdvancedFeatureEngineer":
        self.poly.fit(X)
        return self

    def transform(self, X: pd.DataFrame, y: pd.Series = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
        poly_feats: np.ndarray = self.poly.transform(X)
        feat_names: np.ndarray = self.poly.get_feature_names_out(X.columns)
        X_poly: pd.DataFrame = pd.DataFrame(poly_feats, columns=feat_names)
        # Add custom interaction feature: ratio of first two numeric features (if available)
        if X.shape[1] >= 2:
            X_poly['custom_ratio'] = X.iloc[:, 0] / (X.iloc[:, 1] + 1e-5)
        return X_poly

class RecursiveFeatureSelector(BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin):
    """
    Transformer for feature selection using Recursive Feature Elimination.
    """
    def __init__(self, estimator: any = LogisticRegression(max_iter=500, random_state=42), n_features_to_select: int = 10) -> None:
        self.estimator: any = estimator
        self.n_features_to_select: int = n_features_to_select
        self.selector: RFE = RFE(estimator=self.estimator, n_features_to_select=self.n_features_to_select)

    def fit(self, X: pd.DataFrame, y: pd.Series) -> "RecursiveFeatureSelector":
        self.selector.fit(X, y)
        return self

    def transform(self, X: pd.DataFrame, y: pd.Series = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return X.loc[:, self.selector.support_]

# ==========================
# Data Generation Function
# ==========================

def generate_synthetic_churn_data(n_samples: int = 5000) -> (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series):
    """
    Generates synthetic customer churn dataset.
    Numerical features: tenure, monthly_charges, total_charges, num_products.
    Categorical features: gender, senior_citizen, partner, dependents, contract_type.
    Target: churn (0 or 1)
    """
    np.random.seed(42)
    a: int = n_samples
    # Numerical features
    tenure: np.ndarray = np.random.randint(1, 72, size=a)
    monthly_charges: np.ndarray = np.random.uniform(20, 120, size=a)
    total_charges: np.ndarray = tenure * monthly_charges + np.random.normal(0, 50, size=a)
    num_products: np.ndarray = np.random.randint(1, 5, size=a)
    # Categorical features
    gender: np.ndarray = np.random.choice(['Male', 'Female'], size=a)
    senior_citizen: np.ndarray = np.random.choice(['Yes', 'No'], size=a, p=[0.15, 0.85])
    partner: np.ndarray = np.random.choice(['Yes', 'No'], size=a, p=[0.5, 0.5])
    dependents: np.ndarray = np.random.choice(['Yes', 'No'], size=a, p=[0.3, 0.7])
    contract_type: np.ndarray = np.random.choice(['Month-to-month', 'One year', 'Two year'], size=a, p=[0.6, 0.25, 0.15])
    # Introduce some missing values
    monthly_charges[np.random.choice(a, size=50, replace=False)] = np.nan  # type: ignore
    contract_type[np.random.choice(a, size=30, replace=False)] = None  # type: ignore

    data: pd.DataFrame = pd.DataFrame({
        'tenure': tenure,
        'monthly_charges': monthly_charges,
        'total_charges': total_charges,
        'num_products': num_products,
        'gender': gender,
        'senior_citizen': senior_citizen,
        'partner': partner,
        'dependents': dependents,
        'contract_type': contract_type
    })
    # Target: churn based on some synthetic rule
    churn_prob: np.ndarray = (monthly_charges / 120) + (num_products / 10) + (tenure < 12).astype(int)
    churn: np.ndarray = (churn_prob + np.random.normal(0, 0.2, size=a)) > 1.0
    target: pd.Series = pd.Series(churn.astype(int), name="churn")
    return data, target

# ==========================
# Pipeline Building Function
# ==========================

def build_pipeline() -> Pipeline:
    """
    Constructs the full pipeline for customer churn prediction.
    Components:
      - Preprocessing with ColumnTransformer (numerical and categorical)
      - Outlier removal
      - Advanced feature engineering
      - Feature selection via RFE
      - Data augmentation with SMOTE (applied externally)
      - Ensemble classification using stacking and voting meta-learners
    """
    # Define feature lists
    num_features: list = ['tenure', 'monthly_charges', 'total_charges', 'num_products']
    cat_features: list = ['gender', 'senior_citizen', 'partner', 'dependents', 'contract_type']

    # Numerical pipeline
    num_pipeline: Pipeline = Pipeline(steps=[
        ('imputer', KNNImputer(n_neighbors=5)),
        ('scaler', StandardScaler())
    ])

    # Categorical pipeline
    cat_pipeline: Pipeline = Pipeline(steps=[
        ('imputer', SimpleImputer(strategy='most_frequent')),
        ('encoder', OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore'))
    ])

    # Preprocessor for mixed data
    preprocessor: ColumnTransformer = ColumnTransformer(transformers=[
        ('num', num_pipeline, num_features),
        ('cat', cat_pipeline, cat_features)
    ])

    # Advanced feature engineering and outlier removal
    feature_engineering: Pipeline = Pipeline(steps=[
        ('outlier_removal', OutlierRemover(contamination=0.05)),
        ('adv_feature', AdvancedFeatureEngineer(poly_degree=2, include_bias=False))
    ])

    # Feature selection
    feature_selector: Pipeline = Pipeline(steps=[
        ('rfe', RecursiveFeatureSelector(estimator=LogisticRegression(max_iter=500, random_state=42), n_features_to_select=10))
    ])

    # Dimensionality reduction
    dim_reducer: PCA = PCA(n_components=8, random_state=42)

    # Base classifiers for stacking
    base_estimators: list = [
        ('rf', RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)),
        ('gb', GradientBoostingClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)),
        ('xgb', XGBClassifier(use_label_encoder=False, eval_metric='logloss', random_state=42))
    ]
    meta_learner: LogisticRegression = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, random_state=42)
    stacking_clf: StackingClassifier = StackingClassifier(
        estimators=base_estimators,
        final_estimator=meta_learner,
        cv=5,
        passthrough=True,
        n_jobs=-1
    )
    voting_clf: VotingClassifier = VotingClassifier(
        estimators=base_estimators + [('lr', LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, random_state=42))],
        voting='soft',
        n_jobs=-1
    )
    ensemble_clf: VotingClassifier = VotingClassifier(
        estimators=[('stack', stacking_clf), ('vote', voting_clf)],
        voting='soft',
        n_jobs=-1
    )

    # Full pipeline assembly
    full_pipeline: Pipeline = Pipeline(steps=[
        ('preprocessor', preprocessor),
        ('feature_engineering', feature_engineering),
        ('feature_selector', feature_selector),
        ('dim_reducer', dim_reducer),
        ('classifier', ensemble_clf)
    ])
    return full_pipeline

# ==========================
# Hyperparameter Optimization using Optuna
# ==========================

def objective(trial: optuna.trial.Trial, X_train: pd.DataFrame, y_train: pd.Series) -> float:
    # Hyperparameters for numerical imputer (if needed)
    n_neighbors: int = trial.suggest_int("n_neighbors", 3, 10)
    # Hyperparameters for RandomForest
    rf_n_estimators: int = trial.suggest_int("rf_n_estimators", 50, 200)
    # Hyperparameters for GradientBoosting
    gb_n_estimators: int = trial.suggest_int("gb_n_estimators", 50, 200)
    gb_lr: float = trial.suggest_float("gb_lr", 0.01, 0.3)
    # Hyperparameter for XGBoost
    xgb_n_estimators: int = trial.suggest_int("xgb_n_estimators", 50, 200)
    # Update pipeline parameters
    pipeline: Pipeline = build_pipeline()
    pipeline.set_params(
        preprocessor__num__imputer__n_neighbors=n_neighbors,
        classifier__classifier__stack__rf__n_estimators=rf_n_estimators,
        classifier__classifier__stack__gb__n_estimators=gb_n_estimators,
        classifier__classifier__stack__gb__learning_rate=gb_lr,
        classifier__classifier__stack__xgb__n_estimators=xgb_n_estimators,
        classifier__classifier__vote__lr__C=trial.suggest_float("lr_C", 0.1, 10.0)
    )
    skf: StratifiedKFold = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=3, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    scores: np.ndarray = cross_val_score(pipeline, X_train, y_train, cv=skf, scoring='roc_auc', n_jobs=-1)
    return float(np.mean(scores))

def run_optuna_optimization(X_train: pd.DataFrame, y_train: pd.Series) -> dict:
    study: optuna.study.Study = optuna.create_study(direction='maximize')
    study.optimize(lambda trial: objective(trial, X_train, y_train), n_trials=20, n_jobs=-1)
    return study.best_params

# ==========================
# MLflow Logging Function
# ==========================

def log_experiment(params: dict, metrics: dict, model: any) -> None:
    mlflow.set_experiment("Customer_Churn_Prediction_Pipeline")
    with mlflow.start_run():
        mlflow.log_params(params)
        mlflow.log_metrics(metrics)
        mlflow.sklearn.log_model(model, "churn_model")
        print("Experiment logged with MLflow.")

# ==========================
# Main Execution Function
# ==========================

def main() -> None:
    start_time: float = time.time()

    # Initialize Dask Client for distributed processing
    cluster: LocalCluster = LocalCluster(n_workers=4, threads_per_worker=2)
    client: Client = Client(cluster)
    print("Dask client initiated:", client)

    # Generate synthetic customer churn data
    X: pd.DataFrame
    y: pd.Series
    X, y = generate_synthetic_churn_data(n_samples=5000)
    print("Data generated. X shape:", X.shape, "y shape:", y.shape)

    # Split data into training and test sets
    X_train: pd.DataFrame
    X_test: pd.DataFrame
    y_train: pd.Series
    y_test: pd.Series
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.2, stratify=y, random_state=42)
    print("Data split into training and test sets.")

    # Run hyperparameter optimization
    print("Starting hyperparameter optimization using Optuna...")
    best_params: dict = run_optuna_optimization(X_train, y_train)
    print("Best hyperparameters:", best_params)

    # Build final pipeline with best hyperparameters
    final_pipeline: Pipeline = build_pipeline()
    final_pipeline.set_params(
        preprocessor__num__imputer__n_neighbors=best_params.get("n_neighbors", 5),
        classifier__classifier__stack__rf__n_estimators=best_params.get("rf_n_estimators", 100),
        classifier__classifier__stack__gb__n_estimators=best_params.get("gb_n_estimators", 100),
        classifier__classifier__stack__gb__learning_rate=best_params.get("gb_lr", 0.1),
        classifier__classifier__stack__xgb__n_estimators=best_params.get("xgb_n_estimators", 100),
        classifier__classifier__vote__lr__C=best_params.get("lr_C", 1.0)
    )

    # Handle class imbalance with SMOTE (applied externally before fitting pipeline)
    smote: SMOTE = SMOTE(sampling_strategy=0.3, random_state=42)
    preprocessor: Pipeline = final_pipeline.named_steps["preprocessor"]
    X_train_pre: np.ndarray = preprocessor.fit_transform(X_train)
    X_train_bal: np.ndarray
    y_train_bal: np.ndarray
    X_train_bal, y_train_bal = smote.fit_resample(X_train_pre, y_train)
    # Reconstruct balanced DataFrame (feature names from preprocessor)
    feature_names: list = []
    num_out: np.ndarray = preprocessor.transformers_[0][1].named_steps["scaler"].get_feature_names_out(preprocessor.transformers_[0][2])
    cat_out: np.ndarray = preprocessor.transformers_[1][1].named_steps["encoder"].get_feature_names_out(preprocessor.transformers_[1][2])
    feature_names.extend(num_out.tolist())
    feature_names.extend(cat_out.tolist())
    X_train_bal_df: pd.DataFrame = pd.DataFrame(X_train_bal, columns=feature_names)
    y_train_bal_series: pd.Series = pd.Series(y_train_bal, name="churn")
    print("Applied SMOTE for class imbalance. New training shape:", X_train_bal_df.shape)

    # Fit final pipeline on original training set (pipeline includes feature engineering, selection, etc.)
    print("Fitting final pipeline...")
    final_pipeline.fit(X_train, y_train)

    # Evaluate model on test set
    y_pred: np.ndarray = final_pipeline.predict(X_test)
    test_accuracy: float = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)
    test_auc: float = roc_auc_score(y_test, final_pipeline.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1])
    print(f"Test Accuracy: {test_accuracy:.4f}, Test AUC: {test_auc:.4f}")
    print("Classification Report:\n", classification_report(y_test, y_pred))

    # Model interpretability with SHAP on a sample of test data
    explainer = shap.Explainer(final_pipeline.predict_proba, X_test.iloc[:100])
    shap_values = explainer(X_test.iloc[:100])
    shap.summary_plot(shap_values, X_test.iloc[:100], show=False)
    plt.savefig("shap_summary_plot.png")
    print("SHAP summary plot saved as shap_summary_plot.png")

    # Log experiment with MLflow
    metrics: dict = {"test_accuracy": test_accuracy, "test_auc": test_auc}
    log_experiment(best_params, metrics, final_pipeline)

    # Save final model with joblib
    model_file: str = "final_churn_prediction_pipeline.joblib"
    joblib.dump(final_pipeline, model_file)
    print("Final model saved to", model_file)

    end_time: float = time.time()
    print("Total execution time: {:.2f} seconds".format(end_time - start_time))

    # Shutdown Dask client
    client.shutdown()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
